items.label: 【Ideal Organizer Work Tote】
items.value: The work bags for women come with multi-compartments to meet all your work needs well. items: 【Versatile Computer Bags for Women】This womens laptop tote has length adjustable shoulder strap and handle, is suitable for different body type.The leather bags for women is ideal for daily use at shopping, office, college, business trip, school,travel etc.Perfect gift choice for anniversary, birthday, Mother's Day, Valentine's Day and Christmas.

items.value: Size of the laptop bag is 16.9"Lx6"Wx11.5"H, finished with a secure zip-top closure. items.value: One more gift is a 8.7" L x 5.3" H detachable clutch purse. The additional small bag is made of soft PU leather, has smooth zippper on top closure, polyester lining inside.
